text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown slips from Symboli
Rudolf's
grasp, but that only emboldens
her to make a
better showing in the
Japanese Derby. Her spirit
is far from
broken.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, Эйр Грув and the
general
manager visit the waiting room,
where Symboli
Rudolf waxes lyrical
about her dream.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Moved, the general manager decides to
remain in
the student council, but Air
Groove seems
displeased with Rudolf's
handling of the situation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
